description: I ventured a little away from the areas where people are allowed to actually walk on the travertines and decided to check out the surrounding countryside. Here is one view. Somewhere deep in the earth beneath Pamukkale and the ancient Roman city of Hierapolis lies a vast source of water heated by volcanic lava.
